info.name: Catchpoint REST API v2.0 Account Test API
Returns properties of one or more tests based on test IDs.

params.name: testIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of test IDs to return properties for. Pass “0” against the testId value to get the PostData for a new test creation.

params.name: showInheritedProperties
params.description: Flag to set to see inherited properties as part of the test properties returned

items.docs: Multiple test IDs may be included in a comma-separated list. Results include properties from all sections available in Catchpoint Portal: Test Properties, More Settings, Thresholds, Advanced Settings, Request, Insights, Targeting & Scheduling, and Alerts.

info.name: Delete tests based on the specified list of IDs.

params.name: testIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of test IDs to delete

items.docs: The IDs need to be separated by commas. This endpoint allows partial deletion; if you provide a list of five IDs and only three of them are valid, then it will delete those three tests. The response will indicate the three that were deleted, and the two invalid IDs will be listed as errors.

info.name: Returns tests that match all included parameters.

params.name: productIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of product IDs

params.name: parentFolderIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of folder IDs. The response will only include tests contained immediately with a specified folder

params.name: statusId
params.description: Test status ID. “0” for Active or “1” for Inactive.

params.name: name
params.description: Test name

params.name: url
params.description: Test URLs. The request will only return Web tests with test URLs matching the specified value

params.name: alertsPaused
params.description: “true” for Tests with alerts paused and “false” for tests with alerts unpaused.

params.name: typeIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of test type IDs (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

params.name: monitorIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of monitor IDs (refer InternalLink[Test Enumeration Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_enumeration])

params.name: labelKeyIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of label key IDs

params.name: labelValueIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of label value IDs

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Page number to return records from when the number of records exceeds pageSize

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of results per page. Maximum value is 100.

params.name: includeAdvanceSettings
params.description: Include advanced settings

params.name: includeRequest
params.description: Include request settings

params.name: includeInsight
params.description: Include insights

params.name: includeTargeting
params.description: Include target and scheduling

params.name: includeAlerts
params.description: Include alerts

params.name: showInheritedProperties
params.description: Set to true if inherited properties are to be included in the response

params.name: maximumFrequencyMinutes
params.description: The maximum frequency in minutes that the test runs at

params.name: credentialIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of Credential IDs

items.docs:
All parameters are optional, and if no parameters are provided then details for all active and inactive tests are returned. Results include properties from all sections available in the UI: Test Properties, More Settings, Thresholds, Advanced Settings, Request, Insights, Targeting & Scheduling, and Alerts. The query returns 100 records per page, if there are more than 100 records then the response will have “hasMore” property set to “true”.

info.name: Return the alert state of one or more tests based on test IDs.

params.name: testIds
params.description: Comma-separated list of test IDs to get alert state for

items.docs:
Multiple test IDs may be included in a comma-separated list.
            
Results include the alert state for each of the test ID provided.
            
**Response:**
            
The alert state has status ID and status Name.
            
* Status ID – 0 for Paused, 1 for Unpaused
            
* Status Name – Paused, Unpaused

info.name: Pause or unpause alerts for the specified test IDs.

items.docs:
There can be multiple tests in the payload, each with its own desired state specified. An alert can be paused for a specific time by passing it in the payload.
            
**Request:**
            
Set “pauseExpiration” with < HH >:< MM > as the value.
            
Use alert state status id “0” to pause and “1” to unpause.
            
To get a sample payload to pass along with the request, refer InternalLink[Test Alert State Endpoint,operations-tag-Test,operations-Test-get_v2_tests_ale

info.name: Update a property of an existing test.

params.name: testId
params.description: Test Id of the test to update

params.name: objectDetails
params.description: Set to true to return the updated object in the response body, otherwise the response body will only return the updated object ID.

items.docs:
Only the property that needs to be updated should be passed in the request body, rather than the whole object.
            
Note: Test Type, Test ID, and Division ID cannot be updated. If the Product ID or Folder ID are modified, the test will be moved to that Product or Folder.
            
**Request:**

info.name: Returns the enumeration to help automate test creation.

items.docs: Use parameters to specify which enumeration to pull. If no parameter is passed then it returns all the enumerations. The details returned include the name and the ID to be used for test creation for each section.

info.name: Convert a script to a specified language. Only Selenium (1) to Playwright (3) is currently supported.

params.name: scriptLanguage
params.description: ApiTransactionScriptType Enum value of the original script format

params.name: languageScriptShouldConvertTo
params.description: ApiTransactionScriptType Enum value of the target script format

items.docs:
* scriptLanguage – ApiTransactionScriptType Enum value of the original script format.
